title: Fuobe Soul · the 139 looks
description: Generated by scripts/eval/gen-cases.mjs from the research files; edit the generator, not this file. Each look on three subjects with pinned seeds: the research recipe (look template, triggers, LoRAs at their listed strengths) against the same words without LoRAs, half-strength LoRAs, the bare prompt, and the shipped Original once it exists. Style references (your own or licensed images, never Higgsfield previews) go in local/references/soul/<look>/.

half-strength.description: The recipe with every LoRA at half strength (over-cooking check)

plain.description: The base model with the subject prompt alone

original.description: The shipped Original on the server (O2's fuobe-soul): the look's Fuobe id (v1-general) goes in presetId and the server applies its own recipe
